class.name: RecyclerView
class.brief_description: A virtualized, scrollable list that recycles item views.
class.description:
RecyclerView is the main entry point of the extension: a Control that lays out the items provided by an [b]Adapter[/b] through a [b]LayoutManager[/b], recycles the [b]ViewHolder[/b]s that scroll out of the viewport, and reuses them when new positions scroll in. Only the items that intersect the viewport are instantiated, so arbitrarily large lists render with a constant number of item Controls.
[b]Typical setup[/b] in GDScript: [codeblock] var rv := RecyclerView.new() rv.set_item_extent(40) # default item extent along the scroll axis rv.set_adapter(my_adapter) # an Adapter (or ListAdapter) subclass rv.set_layout(LinearLayoutManager.new()) # or GridLayoutManager / StaggeredGridLayoutManager add_child(rv) [/codeblock]
Data changes are reported through the [code]notify_item_*[/code] methods, which queue incremental updates and apply them at the end of the frame. Scrolling is driven either by mouse/touch input handled internally or by the [code]scroll_*[/code] / [code]set_scroll_offset*[/code] methods. Optional features: item animations ([method set_item_animator]), drag & swipe ([method set_item_touch_helper]), snapping ([method set_snap_helper]) and a scroll bar ([method set_scroll_bar]).
Run the [b]recycler_demo[/b] scene ([code]res://recycler_demo.tscn[/code]) for a working example.

method.name: add_item_decoration
method.description: Adds an [b]ItemDecoration[/b] that draws below items and adds per-item insets (e.g. dividers).

method.name: add_item_view
method.description: Adds a holder's Control to the tree and registers it as a child view.

method.name: add_on_scroll_listener
method.description: Registers a [b]ScrollListener[/b] that receives scroll step and state changes.

method.name: clear_on_scroll_listeners
method.description: Removes all scroll listeners.

method.name: find_child_holder_at
method.description: Hit-test: returns the topmost holder whose layout slot contains the local position.

method.name: free_items
method.description: Frees all item Controls (visible and recycled). Call in teardown to release the Control resources held by the RecyclerView.

method.name: get_adapter_helper
method.description: Returns the internal [b]AdapterHelper[/b] that queues incremental update operations.

method.name: get_child_holder_at
method.description: Returns the ViewHolder at the given child index.

method.name: get_child_holder_count
method.description: Returns the number of ViewHolders currently attached to the tree.

method.name: get_decorated_item_rect
method.description: Returns the actual draw rect of the item at the given position after decoration insets.

method.name: get_item_animator
method.description: Returns the current item animator.

method.name: get_item_decoration_count
method.description: Returns the number of attached item decorations.

method.name: get_item_extent
method.description: Returns the size of the item at [code]position[/code] along the scroll axis, from [method Adapter._get_item_extent] when overridden, otherwise the default [method get_default_item_extent].

method.name: get_item_insets
method.description: Returns the accumulated insets (left, top, right, bottom) applied to the item at the given position.

method.name: get_item_touch_helper
method.description: Returns the current item touch helper.

method.name: get_prefetch_enabled
method.description: Returns whether prefetching is enabled.

method.name: get_recycler
method.description: Returns the internal [b]Recycler[/b] that holds cached and pooled ViewHolders.

method.name: get_scroll_bar
method.description: Returns the current scroll bar, or an invalid Ref when none is set.

method.name: get_scroll_offset
method.description: Returns the current vertical scroll offset.

method.name: get_scroll_offset_horizontal
method.description: Returns the current horizontal scroll offset.

method.name: get_scroll_state
method.description: Returns the current scroll state: one of [constant SCROLL_STATE_IDLE], [constant SCROLL_STATE_DRAGGING] or [constant SCROLL_STATE_SETTLING].

method.name: get_snap_helper
method.description: Returns the current snap helper.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the internal layout [b]State[/b] object used between layouts.

method.name: get_view_for_position
method.description: Returns the [b]ViewHolder[/b] for a position, reusing one from the cache / pool or creating it. Used by LayoutManagers.

method.name: get_viewport_size
method.description: Returns the viewport (this Control's own) size.

method.name: is_item_touch_occupied
method.description: Returns whether the given holder is currently being dragged / swiped by the touch helper.

method.name: layout_children
method.description: Runs a layout pass synchronously.

method.name: notify_data_changed
method.description: Clears all queued updates and relayouts everything from scratch.

method.name: notify_item_moved
method.description: Notifies that an item moved from [code]from_position[/code] to [code]to_position[/code]. Queued and applied at frame end.

method.name: notify_item_range_changed
method.description: Notifies that [code]count[/code] items starting at [code]position[/code] changed content. The optional [code]payload[/code] is passed to [method Adapter._bind_item_with_payload] so only visible cells can be rebound locally. Queued and applied at frame end.

method.name: notify_item_range_inserted
method.description: Notifies that [code]count[/code] items were inserted at [code]position[/code]. Positions at or after it are shifted. Queued and applied at frame end.

method.name: notify_item_range_removed
method.description: Notifies that [code]count[/code] items were removed starting at [code]position[/code]. Positions after the removed range shift down. Queued and applied at frame end.

method.name: recycle_view
method.description: Returns a [b]ViewHolder[/b] to the cache or pool. An animating holder is skipped.

method.name: remove_item_decoration
method.description: Removes a previously added [b]ItemDecoration[/b].

method.name: remove_item_view
method.description: Removes a holder's Control from the tree and unregisters it.

method.name: remove_on_scroll_listener
method.description: Unregisters a previously added [b]ScrollListener[/b].

method.name: request_layout
method.description: Requests a layout; equivalent to a synchronous [method layout_children] in this port.

method.name: scroll_horizontally
method.description: Scrolls horizontally by [code]delta[/code] content pixels. Returns the amount actually scrolled and dispatches [method ScrollListener._on_scrolled].

method.name: scroll_to_position
method.description: Instantly scrolls so that the given position is visible. With the default [b]LayoutManager[/b] orientation the item is aligned to the top of the viewport (normal layout) or the bottom (reverse layout).

method.name: scroll_vertically
method.description: Scrolls vertically by [code]delta[/code] content pixels. Returns the amount actually scrolled (0 when already at a boundary) and dispatches [method ScrollListener._on_scrolled].

method.name: set_item_animator
method.description: Sets the [b]ItemAnimator[/b] used to animate item add/remove/move/change (default: DefaultItemAnimator).

method.name: set_item_touch_helper
method.description: Sets the [b]ItemTouchHelper[/b] used for long-press drag & swipe gestures.

method.name: set_item_view_position
method.description: Positions and sizes a holder's Control, applying item decoration insets.

method.name: set_prefetch_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables prefetching (on by default). Prefetch pre-creates holders just ahead of the viewport to smooth scrolling.

method.name: set_scroll_bar
method.description: Sets the scroll bar ([b]RecyclerViewScrollBar[/b]) and binds it as a child Control. Pass [code]null[/code] to remove it. The bar is pinned to the trailing edge and auto-selects its axis from the layout direction.

method.name: set_scroll_offset
method.description: Sets the vertical scroll offset (in content pixels), clamped to the scrollable range, and relayouts. 0 = start of content.

method.name: set_scroll_offset_horizontal
method.description: Sets the horizontal scroll offset (clamped) and relayouts.

method.name: set_snap_helper
method.description: Sets the [b]SnapHelper[/b] that aligns the list to snapped items after fling / scroll stop.

method.name: smooth_scroll_to
method.description: Smoothly scrolls to [code]target[/code] offset over [code]duration[/code] seconds with a decelerating easing. Used internally by the SnapHelper to settle on a snapped item.

method.name: smooth_scroll_to_position
method.description: Smoothly scrolls so that the given position is visible (same target as [method scroll_to_position], eased over [code]duration[/code] seconds). Useful to jump to the bottom of a chat list.

method.name: stop_scroll
method.description: Stops any in-flight fling / inertial scroll and returns the state to [constant SCROLL_STATE_IDLE].
